newsitem.title: CANADA: CIBC to issue minimum US$173 mln pfd shares.
newsitem.headline: CIBC to issue minimum US$173 mln pfd shares.

text.p: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce said on Thursday that it had reached agreement with underwriters to issue a minimum of preferred shares worth US$173 million.

Canada's second largest bank said it will issue four million preferred A shares, series 17 priced at C$25 each for a yield of 5.45 percent and will issue four million preferred A shares, series 16 at US$25 each for a yield of 5.65 percent.
CIBC said that subject to its agreement with underwriters it could issue an additional four million preferred shares of either series or a combination to a maximum of 12 million shares in total.
